top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: While reviewing directors qualifications on the boad it was seen the Children's Product Certification had not been signed since January 2, 2022. This was corrected at the inspection when a new certification form was signed.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregiver files were missing statements saying the caregiver has received the center's operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Out of the eight children's files reviewed, six were missing a date of admission.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing information on the parents receiving the operational policies.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.
